title: National Body & Mind Screening and Early Intervention Program for Youth with Congenital Heart Disease
summary: Youth with congenital heart disease continue to face particular challenges even after successful heart surgery. They are at increased risk of developing acquired cardiovascular diseases or psychological issues over time, such as post-traumatic stress symptoms, anxiety, depression, or attention disorders.
conditions: Congenital malformations of the circulatory system

interventions.name: This project aims to assess lifestyle, physical, and mental health through a questionnaire-based screening program, comparing affected adolescents with healthy peers. If psychosocial difficulties are identified, participants will be offered the opportunity to take part in an online coaching program.
Arm 2: Control group aged 11-17 years without known structural heart disease

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Group with congenital heart disease: at least one heart surgery
Control group: no known congenital heart defect
Exclusion criteria:
- pronounced neurodevelopmental delay
- syndrome (e.g., Trisomy 21)
- exclusively catheter-based cardiac intervention
-  inpatient hospital stay within the last 3 months
- siblings of patients with surgically treated CHD
